note: NECO English round 6 (R42 top-up): synonyms lucid, meagre, naive, obstinate, placid, prudent, sluggish, zealous; antonyms callous, consented, optional, superior; idioms at daggers drawn, let sleeping dogs lie, pull my leg, throw in the towel, tighten one's belt; third conditional, wish + past perfect, high time + past, among vs between, unless + present; orals - silent b in comb, verb stress in increase, ch in chemistry vs stomach. Scanned against the whole English pool (WAEC and NECO stems).
